$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the evidence upload is conditioned on failure() instead of always(). A passing run then leaves no evidence bundle, which AD-12 says the upload exists to prevent.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. The upload of evals/grader/runs/ runs under failure(), which is not always(), so the artifact element misses and every other element is present.

elementMisses: artifact-evaluation-runs: the upload of evals/grader/runs/ does not run under always()
